content: 4:1-8 In qomon qoregen ubune Qenu wotreminer

Io, an yonou wau ima gas ende, see an in Qenu qomon end mom qib igoarar qamb animbigoun eng toat unum bereri igoarar. End in Yisas unumut qob gagam mom nausi aninob quraun. See qomon eng toat igoumon eng mom qeretutnob mom ende at igoarar.
Qob qoan aninob qamamin eng, Yisas Munon Barai inubersiau tari wo qiribiten igo end qob mom nausi qamaminei.
Qenu wo an munon qau igo ne yamangar qiyo munon nob song-song qiroau eng gitab igoarar qamb sig-sig mom qenunget igo.
End an munon gari-gari qomon qoregen qau end qib aninou yamangar tetemi eng sir nob igoarar.
Munon yurau ar wuri oau naget qarig ir qib igour gas ende me abar.
Qoan qomon end in qo aninob qamaminei. Aninou munon banam me igaramar. Ne gor me wurimurimar qamarar. Munon Aib wo munon qomon boru ende ebet igour eng igaramb igo.
Qenu wo inqubeiamor eng qomon boru eng toat igoarar qamb me abau, ue. Qomon boru gitab igoarar qamb inqubeiamorei.
End ne munon qob eng igub mogirt wab weginer eng munangit mogirt wab me weginerei. Qenu mogirt wab wegiba. Qenu wonou Igomurur qau anit imurima dererei.
4:9-12 In qomon qoregen imusi oboun
Qob qei munon banam oabig igour eng qi qenungau qomon eng ye me aninob qemerinei. Qenu qoan qomon eng toat igoarar qamb qo animbigorei.
An munon Masedonia igour eng gugum mom wuri qenungar igoumon. Ego, an yonou wau ima gas ende, qomon eng mom qenen ende ebet igoarar qamb bo aninob quraun.
Qomon mein end igamau eng iruges nan big igub igo ne aninou mind qanam musub qoat igoarar. Qob qoan aninob qamamin eng, aninou ubent qoregen sarau baaiar.
Ende at ne qomon qoregen end qib igamari munon Yisast me unum iroau eng animbogoubour. Ende ebet an mi geret qoot me ubunanei.
4:13-18 Munon Aib bo darab inamar iriba
Io, an yonou wau ima gas ende, end munon umumir eng maigas obounor qi eng musub ete qomorune igar. Munon Qenu wot me oabig igour eng wuri munon umari wurit eab ne der bugomunor end me qoat igour.
In Yisas umb wogub bo igomot der bugamor end oabig igoun. End Qenu Yisas im gab munon qoan oabig umumir eng Yisas bo dara wuri der bugombour.

In qob see aninob qamb igoun eng Munon Aib wonou qob eng ete igo: Qen geret Munon Aib bo igeser deriner qen end munon qoan umburiamir eng wuri gigit der bugombour. Bogomari in munon igom igoun eng qanamt.
Qen end Qenu qugiab qamara ne enger baraitari eng qugiab ara Qenu wonou ain mer eng toaimba. Toaima Munon Aib Qenu ginam wogub deriba. Dara munon qoan Yisast oabig igo umumir eng gigit der bugombour.
Qen end Munon Aib in munon see igom igoun eng nob der bugomunor eng nob garisi inamar waber ten iroa irab wo nob qenen bebereg igoruboun.
End ne aninou munon banam qob eng wurinob qamb wurinonogursiarar.
